## **![][image1]**

## **WarmChats Admin Page Requirements**

The **Admin section** is for workspace owners, team leaders, and broker/admin users to manage the business side of WarmChats.

Admin should have these tabs:

**Overview, Users, Messaging, Goals, Integrations, Billing & Usage**

---

## **1\. Overview Page**

The Overview page is the admin command center.

It should show the owner/team leader a high-level view of:

* Pipeline value  
* Appointments booked  
* Lead-to-appointment conversion %  
* Closed deals  
* Appointments booked over the last 14 days  
* Appointment types  
* Upcoming appointments  
* Recent closings  
* Volume closed  
* Estimated commission  
* Average deal size

This page is not for chatting with leads. It is for tracking team/business performance.

The data should update based on actual leads, conversations, appointments, pipeline stages, and closed deals inside WarmChats.

---

## **2\. Users Page**

The Users page manages who has access to the workspace.

It should include:

* List of users  
* Name  
* Email  
* Role: Owner, Admin, Agent, Team Member  
* Team  
* Office  
* Status: Active/Inactive  
* Number of assigned leads  
* Invite User button

Admins should be able to invite users, change roles, remove users, and see who belongs to what team or office.

This page should also show account/workspace settings like:

* Email channel status  
* SMS channel status  
* Notification settings  
* Workspace timezone  
* Password/settings area

---

## **3\. Messaging Page**

The Messaging page is for admin-level reporting on communication performance.

It should have two tabs:

**SMS** and **Email**

For SMS, show:

* Texts sent this month  
* Delivery rate  
* Replies  
* Average reply time  
* Opt-outs  
* Texts sent over last 14 days  
* Breakdown by message type:  
  * AI auto-reply  
  * Follow-up sequence  
  * Manual 1-on-1  
  * Appointment reminder

For Email, show:

* Emails sent this month  
* Delivery rate  
* Open rate  
* Click rate  
* Bounces  
* Emails sent over last 14 days  
* Breakdown by email type:  
  * Batch campaign  
  * AI follow-up  
  * Manual 1-on-1  
  * Listing alert

This page helps admins see if SMS/email outreach is working.

---

## **4\. Goals Page**

The Goals page tracks business goals for the team or brokerage.

It should show:

* Commission earned  
* Deals closed  
* Upcoming deals  
* Goal progress %  
* Individual agent progress  
* Earned commission per agent  
* Goal per agent  
* Status: On Track, Behind, At Risk  
* Pipeline toward goal  
* Closed volume  
* Under contract volume  
* Active pipeline

There should also be an **AI Goal Coach** that gives simple recommendations, like:

* Close 2 more deals  
* Book 4 listing appointments  
* Follow up with 18 warm leads  
* View Action Plan

Admins should be able to set goals for themselves, agents, or the whole workspace.

---

## **5\. Integrations Page**

Integrations page is currently **Coming Soon** because integrations are not released yet.

For now, show integrations visually but locked/blurred with a “Coming Soon” state.

Future integrations should include:

* CRM integrations  
* Calendar  
* Dialer  
* Zapier/webhooks  
* Meta leads  
* Google leads  
* Website forms  
* Email/SMS providers

Do not make this fully functional yet unless integration backend is ready.

---

## **6\. Billing & Usage Page**

Billing & Usage controls plan, subscription, usage, invoices, and overages.

It should show plans:

**Free**

* Limited testing plan  
* 1 seat  
* Centralized lead inbox  
* Email outreach only  
* Basic AI/email limits  
* No SMS outreach, auto-replies, advanced sequences, or campaign automation

**Starter**

* $89/month  
* 1 seat  
* 1,250 SMS/month  
* 10,000 emails/month  
* 2,500 AI messages  
* 1,000 calling minutes  
* AI instant reply  
* Lead inbox  
* Templates

**Growth**

* $149/month  
* 1 seat  
* 2,500 SMS/month  
* 20,000 emails/month  
* 15,000 AI messages  
* 3,750 calling minutes  
* AI follow-up sequences  
* Campaign automation  
* Appointment alerts  
* Advanced templates

**Custom Brokerage**

* Custom pricing  
* Multi-agent onboarding  
* Team management  
* AI follow-up automation  
* Shared templates  
* Priority support  
* Custom onboarding  
* Volume pricing

Billing page should also show:

* Current plan  
* Subscription renewal date  
* Manage subscription button  
* Cancel plan button  
* Payment method  
* Usage this cycle  
* Emails used  
* SMS used  
* Calling minutes used  
* AI actions used  
* Invoices with paid status/download

Overage pricing should display:

* Extra SMS: $0.015  
* Extra emails: $0.002  
* Extra AI messages: $0.002  
* Extra calling minutes: $0.015

---

## **Main Admin Logic**

Admin is not just settings. It is the business control center.

Admin should help the owner answer:

* How many leads are coming in?  
* How many appointments are being booked?  
* Which agents are performing?  
* Is AI helping?  
* Are messages being delivered?  
* Are goals on track?  
* What plan/usage are we on?  
* What integrations are connected or coming soon?
